Definition: to braid, i.e. intermix; technically, to traffic (as if by barter); also or give to be security (as a kind of exchange)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to pledge, exchange, mortgage, engage, occupy, undertake for, give pledges, be or become surety, take on pledge, give in pledge; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to take on pledge, go surety for; 1a2) to give in pledge; 1a3) to exchange; 1a4) to pledge; 1b) (Hithpael); 1b1) to exchange pledges; 1b2) to have fellowship with, share
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
